items.title: 4.8 Potential energy aur kinetic energy ka aapas mein badalna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.8 with Figs. 4.12 and 4.13 and Examples 4.5 and 4.6 (PDF 87-89).

blocks.text: Zameen ki satah se oonchai h par sukoon mein mass m ka jism lein (Fig. 4.12). Jagah A par jism ki PE = mgh aur KE = 0 hai. Hum jism chhorte hain, aur jaise woh girta hai hum dekh sakte hain ke us se mutalliq kinetic aur potential energies kaise badalti hain. Jagah B par, jab jism faasla x gir chuka ho (hawa ki raghrat nazar andaz), PE = mg (h - x) aur KE = (1/2) m vB^2. B par velocity vB, vf^2 = vi^2 + 2gS se vf = vB, vi = 0 aur S = x ke saath milti hai: vB^2 = 0 + 2gx = 2gx, is liye KE = (1/2) m (2gx) = mgx. Jagah B par kul energy PE + KE hai: kul energy = mg (h - x) + mgx = mgh ... (4.19). Jagah C par, Zameen se takrane se zara pehle, PE = 0 aur KE = (1/2) m vC^2, jahan vC^2 = vi^2 + 2gh = 2gh kyunke vi = 0; to KE = (1/2) m vC^2 = (1/2) m x 2gh = mgh. Yun nuqte C par kinetic energy jism ki potential energy ki asal qeemat ke barabar hai.

Dar asal jab jism girta hai us ki velocity barhti hai, kyunke woh gravity se tez hota hai; velocity ka izafa us ki kinetic energy barhata hai. Doosri taraf jaise jism girta hai us ki oonchai ghatti hai aur is liye us ki potential energy ghatti hai. Yun hum dekhte hain (Fig. 4.13) ke PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil: mg (h1 - h2) = (1/2) m (v2^2 - v1^2) ... (4.20), jahan v1 aur v2 oonchaiyon h1 aur h2 par jism ki velocities hain. Yeh nateeja sirf tab durust hai jab raghrat ki force na li jaye. Agar neeche ki harkat ke doran raghrat ki force f maujood ho to PE ka ek hissa raghrat ke khilaf kaam mein istemal hota hai, f h ke barabar, aur baqi PE = mgh - f h KE mein badalti hai: mgh - f h = (1/2) m v^2, ya mgh = (1/2) m v^2 + f h ... (4.21). Yun PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil + raghrat ke khilaf kiya kaam, aur is ke ulat KE ka nuqsan = PE ka hasil + raghrat ke khilaf kiya kaam.

blocks.alt: Baen: oonchai h par A se girta jism, B par faasla x gira hua, zameen par C tak, har nuqte par potential aur kinetic energy aur kul mgh ke saath. Darmiyan: oonchaiyon h1 aur h2 par jism velocities v1 aur v2 ke saath aur nuqsan-barabar-hasil equation. Daen: raghrat ki equation aur Example 4.6. Neeche: Example 4.5 ki car P se Q tak 24 m mein 1.5 m charhti hui aur phir R tak hamwar chalti hui.
blocks.caption: Potential energy aur kinetic energy ka aapas mein badalna (Figures 4.12 aur 4.13 aur topic 4.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Oonchai se chhora jism potential energy mgh aur koi kinetic energy nahi se shuru hota hai; kuch faasla girne ke baad us ki speed ka muraba us faasle ka do guna g hai, to us ki kinetic energy us khoi potential energy ke barabar hai aur kul mgh rehta hai, aur utarne se zara pehle sari energy kinetic hai. Aam taur par do oonchaiyon ke darmiyan potential energy ka nuqsan raghrat na ho to kinetic energy ke hasil ke barabar hai; raghrat ho to khoi potential energy ka ek hissa, raghrat ki force zarb oonchai, raghrat ke khilaf kaam mein jata hai aur sirf baqi kinetic energy banti hai, aur yahi hisab charhte hue kinetic energy khote jism ke liye ulta chalta hai. Is liye coast karti car charhai ki choti par charhai aur raghrat par kharch energy se sust pohnchti hai, aur phir hamwar par tab tak chalti hai jab tak raghrat baqi ko kharch na kar de, jabke free fall se sust utarti cheez us par lagi ausat hawa ki raghrat zahir karti hai.

blocks.title: Example 4.5
blocks.text: 1100 kg wazan ki car 12 m s^-1 se chalti hai. Jab woh nuqte P par ho to us ka engine ruk jata hai. Agar raghrat ki force 120 N ho to nuqte Q (1.5 m ooncha, sarak par 24 m) par us ki velocity kya hogi, aur Q se aage rukne se pehle woh kitna door jayegi? Hal: P par kinetic energy juz-wi taur par PE mein badalti aur juz-wi taur par Q tak raghrat ke khilaf kaam mein kharch hoti hai, to KE ka nuqsan = PE ka hasil + raghrat ke khilaf kaam: (1/2) m (vi^2 - vf^2) = w h + f d, (1/2) x 1100 kg x (144 m^2 s^-2 - vf^2) = (1100 kg x 9.8 m s^-2 x 1.5 m) + 120 N x 24 m, 550 kg (144 m^2 s^-2 - vf^2) = 16170 kg m^2 s^-2 + 2880 kg m^2 s^-2, (144 m^2 s^-2 - vf^2) = 19050 / 550 = 34.6 m^2 s^-2, vf^2 = 144 - 34.6 = 109.4 m^2 s^-2. Q par velocity: vf = sqrt(109.4) = 10.5 m s^-1. Agar car nuqte R par ruke to (1/2) m v^2 = f S: (1/2) x 1100 kg x 109.4 m^2 s^-2 = 120 kg m s^-2 x S, to S = taqreeban 501 m.

blocks.title: Example 4.6
blocks.text: 3 kg mass ki cheez 15 m ki oonchai se girti hai aur 16 m s^-1 se zameen se takrati hai. Hawa ki raghrat ki ausat force nikalein. Hal: PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil + raghrat ke khilaf kiya kaam; chunke vi = 0, w h = (1/2) m v^2 + f h: 3 kg x 9.8 m s^-2 x 15 m = (1/2) x 3 kg x (16 m s^-1)^2 + f x 15 m, 441 kg m^2 s^-2 = 384 kg m^2 s^-2 + 15 m x f, ya f = (441 - 384) kg m^2 s^-2 / 15 m = 3.8 kg m s^-2 = 3.8 N.

blocks.prompt: 200 g ka seb 10 m uthaya aur giraya jata hai; agar uthane ke kaam ka 75% utarne tak KE bane to utarne ki speed nikalein (numerical 4.10). Jhoole par bachcha 0.5 m se 1.5 m tak uthta hai; zyada se zyada speed kya hai (MCQ 4.4)? Kya hawa mein girta jism apni kul mechanical energy rakhta hai (short question 4.3)?
blocks.explanation: Uthane ka kaam = mgh = 0.2 x 9.8 x 10 = 19.6 J; utarne par KE = 0.75 x 19.6 = 14.7 J = (1/2)(0.2) v^2, to v = sqrt(147) = 12.1 m s^-1. PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil: v = sqrt(2 g x 1.0) = sqrt(19.6) = 4.4 m s^-1. Nahi: PE ka hissa hawa ki raghrat ke khilaf kaam mein kharch hota hai, to mechanical energy (PE + KE) f h se ghatti hai; sirf garmi samet kul energy baqi rehti hai.

items: h se girna: A par PE = mgh, KE = 0; B par (x gira) PE = mg(h - x), KE = mgx, kul mgh (4.19); C par KE = mgh. PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil: mg(h1 - h2) = (1/2) m (v2^2 - v1^2) (4.20), raghrat nahi.

Raghrat ke saath: mgh = (1/2) m v^2 + f h (4.21); PE ka nuqsan = KE ka hasil + raghrat ke khilaf kaam, aur charhte jism ke liye ulta. Misalein: Q par 10.5 m s^-1 aur rukne tak 501 m; hawa ki raghrat 3.8 N.
